preconditions.description: The length of the input string s must be between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in the input string s must be lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NA' or (len(stdout) == len(s) + 1 and stdout == stdout[::-1])
postconditions.description: If it is not possible to form a palindrome, output 'NA'. Otherwise, the output must be a palindrome of length len(s) + 1.
